notes: The local curl/Python HTTPS runner was blocked by WinError 10013 before the first query; the same 21 topic searches were completed through the connected GitHub search surface.
SSI2130, SSI2131, SSI2140, SSI2144, SSI2164, and SSI2190 were each researched explicitly; supplemental exact-part search surfaced TimMJN/Polymorph-VCO and brer-rabbit/zoxnoxious.
Every selected repository has current file or hardware evidence and an explicit Daisy Seed or Teensy 4 portability judgment.

selected.description: Functional programming language for signal processing and sound synthesis
selected.content_summary: Current tree exposes embedded, compiler, benchmark, examples, and tests; representative DSP files include architecture/faust/vst/voice.h, benchmark/fdelay8.dsp, and benchmark/filterseq2x8.dsp.
selected.portability_summary: FAUST can generate compact C/C++ DSP cores, so desktop impulse tests can remain the reference while the generated block runs on Daisy Seed or Teensy 4.
selected.reuse_idea: Generate one delay or filter as plain C++, compare its impulse response against the desktop backend, then profile the same block at the target audio-buffer size.

selected.description: Brickworks is a music DSP toolkit with portable building blocks for audio engines
selected.content_summary: Current code search verifies include/bw_delay.h plus examples/fx_delay/src/plugin.h and the repository also carries chorus, flanger, noise-gate, tests, and C/C++ build assets.
selected.portability_summary: The header-first C/C++ DSP blocks are already isolated from host UI code and are suitable for fixed-block Daisy Seed or Teensy 4 integration.
selected.reuse_idea: Lift bw_delay and one modulation effect into a target-neutral test harness, then add only the board-specific audio callback and parameter smoothing.

selected.description: Analog synthesizer and software interface with an SSI2130/AS3394 voice card, Raspberry Pi control, and VCV Rack integration
selected.content_summary: Current files include kicad/z5524/ssi2130.kicad_sch, kicad/z5524/z5524.kicad_pro, raspberry_pi/lib/src/z5524/tuning.c, and vcv_rack/src/Zoxnoxious5524.cpp.
selected.portability_summary: The analog voice, tuning, DAC-control, and audio-I/O design is reusable, but the Raspberry Pi and VCV Rack layers need a new MCU control transport.
selected.reuse_idea: Reuse the SSI2130 tuning and control-voltage partitioning while replacing the Pi/VCV bridge with a Daisy or Teensy SPI-DAC control task.

selected.description: Standalone and plug-in host for cycle-accurate classic synth, sampler, CPU, and DSP emulation cores
selected.content_summary: The current tree exposes Modules/SFZero/sfzero/SFZSynth.cpp, SFZVoice.cpp, source/, and Retromulator.jucer rather than only host metadata.
selected.portability_summary: The voice and sampler engines are separable from JUCE, although individual emulation cores must be profiled before selecting a Daisy or Teensy subset.
selected.reuse_idea: Start with the ROM-free SFZero voice path, cap polyphony, and measure interpolation cost before considering the heavier cycle-accurate synth cores.

selected.description: SSI2130 voltage-controlled oscillator for Kosmo and Eurorack with through-zero FM, suboscillator, and voltage-controlled waveform mixing
selected.content_summary: The repository contains PCB, datasheets, and schematic+BOM folders; verified fabrication assets include PCB/Polymorph_VCO-PCB_back.png, PCB/Polymorph_VCO-PCB_front.png, and PCB/Polymorph_VCO-Panel_drill_guide.pdf.
selected.portability_summary: Its value is the SSI2130 analog signal path and calibration method; a Daisy or Teensy controller would add digital tuning, modulation, and preset control around that hardware.
selected.reuse_idea: Use the oscillator and calibration network as the analog voice, then add MCU-generated precision CV and a calibration table without moving the waveform core into DSP.

selected.description: Rust DSP kernel with a no_std core, CLAP host build, modular graph, and Daisy Seed export path
selected.content_summary: Current code search verifies crates/sonido-core/src/biquad.rs, crates/sonido-core/src/dsp/tone_stack.rs, crates/sonido-analysis/src/filterbank.rs, and crates/sonido-core/benches/core_bench.rs.
selected.portability_summary: The no_std core and explicit Daisy target keep the DSP graph independent from the desktop plug-in and GUI layers.
selected.reuse_idea: Use its no_std biquad and tone-stack benchmarks to choose a safe per-block node budget before exporting a compact Daisy pedal graph.

selected.description: Firmware and software for a Teensy 4.1 and TAC5212 codec audio hardware ecosystem
selected.content_summary: The current tree exposes projects, lib, and PlatformIO firmware; representative voice files include firmware/mix-kit/src/DexedVoiceBank.cpp, DexedVoiceGains.h, and DrumVoice.h.
selected.portability_summary: It already targets Teensy 4.1 with a modern codec and exposes reusable voice, control, and board-integration patterns.
selected.reuse_idea: Extract the new independent Plaits-track scheduling and benchmark it against the TAC5212 callback budget before copying the pattern into another multitimbral target.

selected.description: Compact ESP32-S3 audio development board for synths, samplers, effects, sequencers, storage, and playback
selected.content_summary: Verified hardware assets include ESP32-Seed-2.kicad_pcb, ESP32-Seed-2.kicad_sch, DSP32-CORE-Schematic.pdf, DSP32-CORE-BOM.csv, and a Gerber archive.
selected.portability_summary: The board files are directly useful for compact ESP32 audio hardware, while Daisy or Teensy reuse is mainly codec, power, storage, and connector design guidance.
selected.reuse_idea: Audit the codec, flash, SD-card, and power sections as a compact reference design before adapting only the proven audio-path blocks to another MCU carrier.

selected.description: Cross-platform Cython wrapper for the FAUST interpreter with RtAudio
selected.content_summary: The current tree contains src, include, tests, CMake, and Make build assets; verified files include src/cyfaust/__main__.py, resources/architecture/minimal.cpp, and resources/libraries/examples/generator/noise.dsp.
selected.portability_summary: The wrapper is desktop-oriented, but it is a useful rapid FAUST regression harness before compiling selected DSPs to embedded C++.
selected.reuse_idea: Use the Python binding to sweep parameters and capture golden audio, then compile the same FAUST source into a headless Daisy or Teensy test.

selected.description: Open replacement Nest Audio PCB using ESP32-S3 and XMOS DSP for local voice and audio control
selected.content_summary: The current repository retains hardware/bom/bill-of-materials.csv and hardware/kicad/nest-audio-pcb.kicad_pro as concrete audio-board implementation evidence.
selected.portability_summary: Its main value is audio PCB and ESP32-S3/XMOS bring-up rather than portable DSP source, but the board architecture is directly reusable for standalone audio hardware.
selected.reuse_idea: Reuse the power, microphone, speaker, and interprocessor partitioning as a checklist for a local-voice or networked audio carrier before committing to XMOS.
